card.name: Linking words before co-treatment or term
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "with", "for", "and/or" right after "coadministered", "in combination", "treated" or "Criteria" in oncology drug labels. The next word is usually a drug name or a named term.

modes.label: With after combination
modes.description: "with" after "coadministered", "in combination" or "treated", before a second drug.
modes.example: 75 mg 75 mg Encorafenib exposure at the 75 mg QD BRAFTOVI dosage when coadministered<< with>> a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor

modes.label: Linking word in a set phrase
modes.description: "for" in "Criteria for Adverse Events", or "and/or" between outcome terms.
